name: Lasso Select
description: Togglable lasso selection for the editor!

enable-alt.name: Alt to Enable
enable-alt.description: Allows you to press Alt (Option on MacOS and iOS) to enable lasso selection without pressing the button.

copilot-key.name: Joke Alt Icon
copilot-key.description: Uses the Copilot icon instead of Alt (Option on MacOS and iOS) for the modifier key. Does not change actual functionality.
